description: Split manifest — defines training/validation/prediction/falsification/evaluation splits for all experiments

definition.description: Data used to define (discover) a concept or law
definition.source: Randomly sampled trajectory from experiment with fixed parameters

test_on_test.description: 10 held-out trajectories with different random parameters, used by SpecificModel.test_on_test_experiment()

experiment_control.description: Controlled variations: change one object or global parameter, re-run

general_law_validation.description: General laws tested on ALL registered experiments, not just source

current_violations.description: Current known issues with split management

issues.description: test_on_test_experiment uses 10 random trajectories from same parameter family as definition data. While parameters differ, the apparatus family is identical.
issues.mitigation: Phase 5 will add cross-apparatus-family test experiments.

issues.description: experiment_control variations use the same simulator. External validation on real data is not performed.
issues.mitigation: This is inherent to simulator-based discovery. Real-data validation is a separate phase.

issues.description: No explicit tracking of which data points were used to define which concepts/laws. The system relies on stochastic resampling for test_on_test and experiment_control.
issues.mitigation: The provenance tracker (provenance.py) will record definition-data associations as concepts are registered.

definition_to_concept_map.description: Maps each registered concept to the experiments and data splits that defined it. Populated at runtime.
